convert_fullcell_to_she: convert a full cell voltage value to the standard hydrogen electrode scale using get_she
convert_fullcell_to_halfcell: convert a full cell voltage to half cell values vs SHE and RHE using fullcell2halfcell
load_calibration_data: load the calibration data dictionary for voltage conversion using load_calibration_data_for_voltage_conversion
convert_she_to_rhe: convert a standard hydrogen electrode potential to the reversible hydrogen electrode scale using she2rhe
correct_potential_ir_drop: correct an electrode potential for IR drop and convert to RHE using correct_potential
